sections.text: حَشد

Install diffusers, sleeves, and impellers from 
 the discharge side up to suction side and tight them with the clamping bolts.

Insert shaft in the suction slide bearing with 
 lantern and check radial and axial clearance of the pump and ensure that pump 
 rotate easily, otherwise dismount and treat the causes.

Install the shaft joints with their mafe 
 couplings,
قم بتركيب أنابيب توجيه العمود.

Install the hanger complete with discharge 
 elbow into shaft guide pipes.
Mount the stuffing box with gland.
Mount the thrust bearing and cover it.
Install the pump half coupling.

Lift the pump by crane and put it in its 
 place.
Fix the pump and tight all attached pipes.

Install packing cords and tight gland bolts 
 easily.

Adjust the axial clearance of the pump by a 
 value equal to one half of all axial clearance, by the nut.
Mount the electric motor.

Adjust the alignment between motor shaft and 
 pump shaft and record them.
